Product Change Notification
Northgate Microsystems
This notification informs customers that the identified parts are transitioning to a new manufacturing site. The transfer of assembly is complete and the certification report is available on request.
The mold compound used for the affected packages changes with this notification. There is no change to the form, fit or function of the affected parts.
Customers with further questions about this notification should contact their Northgate Microsystems field sales engineer, who will gather the information and coordinate the transition with the operations team.
This notification prints no notification date and no publication date anywhere in its text, which is the one property the fixture exists to hold: a notice with no date is a valid notice.
